note: Curated Hub/metadata best-practice tips, one per day, rotated by date. Add entries; keep titles short and bodies one paragraph.

tips.title: Model cards are your front page
tips.body: The README.md of a Hub repo renders before anything else — a card with Model Details, Uses, and Limitations sections converts viewers into users.

tips.title: License before code
tips.body: A repo with no license is legally unusable for most companies. Set the license tag in Hub settings AND in the card frontmatter.

tips.title: Tags drive discoverability
tips.body: Hub search, filters, and the Models/Datasets pages rank by tags. Aim for 5+ (framework, task, modality, language, license).

tips.title: frontmatter = structured metadata
tips.body: YAML frontmatter in the card is parsed by the Hub into fields (license, tags, metrics) that APIs and widgets use. Keep keys lowercase.

tips.title: library_name unlocks auto-loading
tips.body: Setting library_name (transformers, diffusers...) lets the Hub offer 'Use in Transformers' code snippets and auto-download.

tips.title: config.json is not optional
tips.body: Gated loading, pipelines, and most frameworks require config.json with model_type. Always save_pretrained() it.

tips.title: State metrics or stay silent
tips.body: A claimed accuracy with no eval set or methodology is worse than none. Report metric, dataset, and split together.

tips.title: base_model is a legal field now
tips.body: Derivative models should declare base_model — licensing and attribution of fine-tunes depend on it.

tips.title: Datasets are part of reproducibility
tips.body: Link the training data via the datasets field. It is the single biggest trust signal for ML repos.

tips.title: pipeline_tag == instant demo
tips.body: Models with pipeline_tag render inference widgets on the Hub page — the fastest 'wow' for visitors.

tips.title: Spaces need an explicit SDK
tips.body: sdk: streamlit | gradio | static | docker | custom in frontmatter; an unbuildable Space is a dead link.

tips.title: HTTPS or it didn't happen
tips.body: Plain http:// links in cards get flagged by scanners and often blocked by corporate proxies. Force https.

tips.title: Lint before you publish
tips.body: Run hf-hub-lint on a repo before sharing it — a 90+ score card takes 5 minutes and removes an obvious first impression problem.

tips.title: Gated repos still need cards
tips.body: A gated model's card is public even when weights are not — reviewers decide whether to request access based on it.

tips.title: Deterministic linting scales
tips.body: Script hf-hub-lint --json into CI so card regressions fail the build before they ship to the Hub.

tips.title: One model card template
tips.body: Copy an excellent card (e.g. any top-100 model) and adapt it. The Sections check here flags what a template usually has.

tips.title: Inference widgets need examples
tips.body: Add a widget example (sample input) to the card so the live widget shows real output on first load.

tips.title: Version your Hub repo
tips.body: Use git tags on Hub repos; the API exposes them and downstream users pin versions.

tips.title: Dataset cards need provenance
tips.body: Include collection method, date, and license of source data — the #1 review question for datasets.

tips.title: Keep README encoding sane
tips.body: UTF-8, no BOM, LF endings. Broken encodings make the card render garbled on the Hub.

tips.title: Emoji are fine, noise is not
tips.body: A banner emoji or two is OK; a wall of them hurts searchability and looks spammy to reviewers.

tips.title: CI-lint your own docs
tips.body: Add the linter to a pre-commit hook; catch CARD_TRIM before your README becomes a stub.

tips.title: The score is a heuristic
tips.body: hf-hub-lint scores metadata hygiene, not model quality. Use it as a checklist, not a judgment of the artifact.

tips.title: Metadata debt compounds
tips.body: Fix metadata when the repo is fresh; nobody retrofits a model card on a 2-year-old repo.
